Love Leam

Leamington has a vibrant community that loves nothing more than to drink, eat and be merry. It often tops the lists of the best places to live in the Midlands, and even won the award for the happiest place to live in the UK in 2017.

The hospitality sector has taken a real hit recently, first Brexit, then lockdown and now the cost of living crisis. Despite this Leamington is blooming (much like its finest park, Jephson Gardens), and a superb foodie scene has started to grow.
